input.format: UTF-8 comma-separated CSV with optional BOM; strict rectangular records and unique named headers
input.extra_columns: preserved in original local records; not features

required_values.LineId: positive integral digit string; repeated IDs retained

input.timestamp_policy: Date/Day/Time preserved as strings; no year, timezone, full timestamp or window inferred

source_ip.attribution: exactly one distinct valid peer and no invalid supported-context token
source_ip.ipv4_separator: validate original token first; only from context permits strict dotted IPv4 plus exactly one terminal colon, removed once before strict validation
source_ip.ipv6: validate original full token; never strip meaningful colons or repair invalid syntax
source_ip.missing_or_ambiguous: retain original event; exclude from IP feature vectors; never assign candidate addresses or zero-fill baseline IPs

aggregation.scope: one supplied historical file, grouped by canonical SourceIP
aggregation.window_assumptions: no fixed duration; no cross-file comparability guarantee for count/exposure features
aggregation.deduplication: none; each CSV data-record position counts once, including repeated messages and LineIds
aggregation.empty_supported_set: zero feature rows with all output headers; not an inference-ready dataset

event_type.definition: id: + original EventId if nonblank; otherwise template: + original EventTemplate
event_type.normalization: blank checks use strip; nonblank original value is not stripped or rewritten

authentication.counting: boolean indicator per row, at most one contribution to each count
authentication.overlap: failure and invalid-user counts are independent; both increment on overlap
authentication.accepted_failure_ambiguity: retain both flags, report ambiguity, still count failure once

features.name: EventCount
features.formula: number of assigned rows for SourceIP

features.name: UniqueEventTypes
features.formula: distinct derived event-type strings among assigned rows

features.name: FailedAuthCount
features.formula: sum of failure indicators among assigned rows

features.name: InvalidUserCount
features.formula: sum of invalid-user indicators among assigned rows

features.name: FailedAuthRate
features.formula: FailedAuthCount / EventCount; generated groups always have EventCount > 0

preprocessing.validation: reuse prepare_features; reject missing/blank/nonfinite/nonnumeric values, fractional/negative counts, rates outside [0,1], invalid IPs and float32 overflow
preprocessing.selection: persisted ColumnTransformer whitelist in feature_order, remainder=drop
preprocessing.fit_scope: training data only; inference never refits

provenance.input_hash_policy: SHA-256 exact input bytes in a private local run manifest; no invented or placeholder real-data hashes
provenance.legacy_baseline_generation: unverified; not reconstructed from mismatches or previous model predictions

compatibility_requirements: exact contract identity and canonical digest
reviewed implementation hashes and dependency versions
verified training input hashes and membership provenance
approved independent evaluation and Project Manager authorization
